name: Parallel PR Review
description: Runs code review, error handler review, and test coverage review in parallel, then synthesizes findings into a prioritized action list. Use after completing a feature branch before creating a PR.

nodes.prompt: Synthesize findings from $review-code.output, $review-errors.output, $review-tests.output into a prioritized list: 1) Blockers, 2) Concerns, 3) Nits.
